title: Sudoku: how to play
sections: Fill every empty square with a number from 1 to 9 so that every row, every column and every 3 x 3 box holds each number exactly once.

Tap a square, then a number on the pad. Notes mode writes small pencil marks instead (handy for squares with a few possible numbers). Erase clears a square, Undo takes back a move, and Hint fills in one correct number.
A number shown in red appears twice in the same row, column or box. Fix it before going on.

Look for a number that can only go in one place in a box, row or column. Squares with only one possible number are free points. When stuck, put pencil marks in a box and look for numbers that fit in one square only.
Easy starts with 44 numbers filled in, Normal with 34, Hard with 27. Harder puzzles and faster solves score more; every hint costs points.
